title: Claude Code Tutorial for Beginners: From Install to Your First Autonomous Task
summary: Step-by-step Claude Code tutorial: install in 5 minutes, write your first CLAUDE.md, run your first autonomous coding task, and use plan mode to stay in control.
body_markdown: Copilot completes lines as you type — it's inline autocomplete inside your editor. Claude Code takes full tasks from a terminal prompt and handles multi-file, multi-step work autonomously. You don't need to be in an editor at all. Many developers use both: Copilot for line-level suggestions while writing, Claude Code for larger autonomous tasks.
